**Supplerende analyser 7** (Supplementary Analysis 7) is a dedicated analytical section within the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] report, which monitors clinical quality indicators for atrial fibrillation in the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. While the report's primary Indicator 11 tracks severe bleeding within the first year following a new atrial fibrillation diagnosis, Supplerende analyser 7 broadens this scope by focusing specifically on the occurrence of severe bleeding among *prevalent* patients—those already living with the condition [^src1]. This distinction is highly significant, as it provides a more comprehensive picture of the long-term safety profile of anticoagulation treatments in real-world clinical practice than Indicator 11 alone [^src1].

For the reporting period spanning July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the analysis revealed that 2.14% of prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation developed severe bleeding [^src1]. By evaluating this clinical indicator alongside other metrics like heart failure (Indicator 15), the report enables regional comparisons and helps identify variations in patient outcomes across different Danish regions, health clusters, and specific cluster areas [^src1]. Ultimately, this supplementary analysis serves as a vital tool for quality improvement and political governance, ensuring that the long-term risks of anticoagulation therapy are continuously monitored and managed [^src1].
